label: About
title: Engineering that starts from the problem.
lead: MERAVIN is a software engineering company. We develop digital products and business software: websites, web applications, CRM systems, Telegram bots, APIs and automation.

principles.title: Start with the business task
principles.description: Work begins with the problem to solve — not with a preset template or a fixed technology stack.

principles.title: Architecture to fit the project
principles.description: Technical choices follow the requirements of that project: what needs to be built, who will use it, and how it should be maintained.

principles.title: Checked before launch
principles.description: Quality is verified before release. Support after launch is agreed separately for each project.
